Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of permission P/2022/0026.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted
(Energy and Sustainability Statement Rev. B - received 10th August 2022
PL110 Rev. P02, PL111 Rev. P02, PL112 Rev. P02, PL113 Rev. P02, PL120 Rev. P02, Design Statement of changes, Energy Statement Addendum, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment � received 24th April 2025
Urban Greening Factor � received 22nd May 2025
Summary Acoustic Design Info, Transport Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Fire Strategy, Phase 2 Site Investigation Report, Landscape Management and Maintenance Plan, Bird Hazard Management Plan, Air Quality Assessment, swept path muckaway, swept path delivery vehicle, swept path HGV, swept path refuse vehicle, Typical tree planting detail, The green planting plan, planting plan � received 17th June 2025
SLP100 Rev. P02, PL100 Rev. P03, PL101 Rev P03, PL102 Rev. P03, PL103 Rev. P03, PL104 Rev. P03, PL001 Rev. P03 � received 30th June 2025)
therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - Prior to commencement of works above ground level, the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing, details and samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted.
The samples/details shall include:
 - Brick/concrete (including brick detail, soldier coursing, mortar colours, joint type, brick bond and sample panels a minimum size of 1m x 1m);
 - Reglit glass and balcony balustrades;
 - Doors and window treatments (including sections and reveals) and;
 - Any other materials/details to be used.
The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.
Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development, in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and protect living conditions, to satisfy the requirements of Local Plan Policies CC1 and CC2.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in accordance with the Bird Hazard Management Plan � received 17th June 2025.
Reason: It is necessary to manage the flat roofs to minimise its attractiveness to birds which could endanger the safe movement of aircraft and the operation of Heathrow Airport.
Condition : 5 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development the boundary treatment shall be erected in strict accordance with the approved plans.
Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of adjoining properties in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1 and CC2.
Condition : 6 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details set out in the following drawings: PL100 Rev. P03, PL001 Rev. P03 � received 30th June 2025 and Landscape Management and Maintenance Plan, Typical tree planting detail, The green planting plan, planting plan � received 17th June 2025
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the area and to promote biodiversity, in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1 and GB7 and London Plan Policies G6 and G7.
Condition : 7 - A. The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the approved Energy and Sustainability Statement Rev B received on 10 August 2022 and the Energy Statement Addendum received 24th April 2025.
B. Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
C. Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.
D. If the development as implemented fails to result in a net zero-carbon development, as indicated by the first set of data recovered under clause 'C' above, the applicant shall, within six months of first occupation have entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure a suitable contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund to compensate fully for this shortfall at the rate applicable at the time of first occupation.
Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy SI 2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.
Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.
Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI 5 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.
Condition : 9 - The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
- At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
- At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
- No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with the London Plan Policy SI 2 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.
Condition : 10 - All windows serving bathrooms of the hereby approved development as shown on the approved drawings shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of future occupiers in accordance with Local Plan Policy CC2.
Condition : 11 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan approved under application P/2024/2934 approved on 21st November 2024.
Reason: To ensure that the construction takes place in an acceptable manner and would not cause harm to neighbouring buildings or the wider area; in accordance with Local Plan Policies EC1 and EC2.
Condition : 12 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.
c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. 
All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142:2014(Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.
Reason: To ensure that there would be no harm to neighbour's living conditions in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5.
Condition : 13 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the existing access junction along the full length of the site boundary on Oxford Way shall be converted to a continuous footway with dropped kerb and vehicular crossover. No fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 metres in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected on land within the developer's ownership. A clear 1.2 metre pedestrian access route shall be made available and shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: In the interests of road safety in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EC2.
Condition : 14 - The levels of disabled persons parking for Blue Badge holders shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved drawings for at least one Blue Badge bay and shall be implemented before the development hereby approved is occupied and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: To ensure that the proposal complies with Local Plan Policy EC2.
Condition : 15 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure, covered, cycle parking facilities (for not less than 28 bicycles) for the occupants of the development and short stay cycle parking facilities (for not less than four bicycles) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives; in accordance London Plan Policy T5 coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2021 and Local Plan Policy EC2.
Condition : 16 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development the waste and recycling storage shown on the approved drawings shall be made available for use in strict accordance with the approved plans and shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: To ensure the storage areas are suitable for use and in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ7.
Condition : 17 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development a waste management strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show how waste will be managed on site specifically on waste collection days. Waste management shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: In the interests of the amenity of the area and to ensure the arrangements for waste collection are suitable in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ7.
Condition : 18 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until, the works depicted on drawing number 337-P15-18 (Wider Improvements) have been implemented in their entirety. 
The works shall be made available for use in strict accordance with the approved plans and shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: To enhance the public realm and ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the adjacent area in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and SC5.
Condition : 19 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:
(A) Part A of condition 13 has been approved under application P/2024/2922 dated 29th October 2024. The development must be undertaken in accordance with the previously approved details and the Phase II Supplementary Site Investigation.
(B) If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the local planning authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the local planning authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
During the course of the development:
(C) The local planning authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the local planning authority for approval in writing before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first occupied:
(D) The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses (B) and (C) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
Supporting notes:
a. An initial phase 1 desk study has been submitted with the original application and is considered satisfactory. A phase 2 intrusive investigation will need to be submitted and will include investigation into outstanding potential contamination issues to be communicated by the local planning authority and allow the development of a site Conceptual Model (CM), which identifies all potential pollutant linkages on the site.

Condition : 20 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations [and an updated Drainage Assessment Form] to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority. The drainage hierarchy shall make use of green infrastructure technology to comply with the hierarchy set out in London Plan Policy SI 13 and the runoff rate shall not exceed 2.5 litres/second. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.
Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site, in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to London Plan policies SI 12 and SI 13 (and its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG), the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Local Plan Policy EQ3.
Condition : 21 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.
Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed, in accordance with the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan policies SI 12 and SI 13 (together with associated guidance to these policies) and Local Plan Policy EQ3.
Condition : 22 - The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the recommendations approved in the Preliminary Ecological Assessment received on 12 January 2022.
Reason: In the interest of maintaining ecology and to result in a net gain in biodiversity in accordance with Local Plan Policy GB7 and Policies G6 and G7 of the London Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2021 and under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
Condition : 23 - The hereby approved development shall be implemented in accordance with the recommendations contained in the Arboricultural Impact Assessment during construction to protect the health of existing trees and shall be maintained as such for the duration of the construction works.
Reason: To ensure that the trees are adequately protected and in particular to avoid unnecessary damage to its root systems during construction and following the completion of the development, in accordance with Local Plan Policy GB7.
Condition : 24 - Prior to occupation, the development shall achieve 'Secured by Design' accreditation awarded by the Design-Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the Association of Chief Police Officers (ACPO).
No dwelling shall be occupied until accreditation has been achieved and evidence of such accreditation has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In pursuance of the Council's duty under section 17 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 to consider crime and disorder implications in excising its planning functions; to promote the well-being of the area in pursuance of the Council's powers under section 2 of the Local Government Act 2000 and to ensure the development provides a safe and secure environment in accordance with Policy CC2 of the Local Plan (adopted 2015) and Policy D11 of the London Plan (adopted 2021) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework 2021.
Condition : 25 - All Non-road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) used during the course of the development that is within the scope of the GLA 'Control of Dust and Emissions during Construction and Demolition' Supplementary Planning Guidance (SPG) dated July 2014, or any successor document, shall comply with the emissions requirements therein.
Reason: In the interests of Air Quality and to satisfy the requirements of Local Plan Policy EQ4.
Condition : 26 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures proposed in the approved Air Quality Assessment received on 17th June 2025.
Reason: In the interests of Air Quality and to satisfy the requirements of Local Plan Policy EQ4.
Condition : 27 - The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the recommendations of the approved Noise Impact Assessment Report and Planning Compliance Report received on 24 November 2022 and comply with the requirements of BS 8233:2014 to provide sound insulation against externally generated noise with good acoustic design of the building envelopment and a means of ventilation provided.
Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted post completion noise tests shall be carried out by accredited/approved organisations in order to demonstrate that this has been achieved. The test reports shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The measures shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: In the interests of residential amenity and to ensure the development accords with Local Plan Policy EQ5.
Condition : 28 - No piling shall take place until a Piling Method Statement (detailing the depth and type of piling to be undertaken and the methodology by which such piling will be carried out, including measures to prevent and minimise the potential for damage to subsurface sewerage infrastructure, and the programme for the works) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority in consultation with Thames Water. 
Any piling must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved piling method statement.
Reason: The proposed works will be in close proximity to underground sewerage utility infrastructure. Piling has the potential to significantly impact or cause failure of local underground sewerage utility infrastructure.
description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans), 4 (Bird Hazard Management Plan), 6 (Landscaping), 7 (Energy), 10 (Obscured glazing), 11 (Construction Logistics Plan), 14 (Accessible Parking), 16 (Waste and recycling storage), 19 (Contamination), 23 (Arboriculture), and 26 (Air Quality) to allow the increase in the number of flats from 17 units to 18 units and alter the design of planning permission P/2022/0026 approved 17th January 2023 for Demolition of the existing garages and erection of a residential building with associated cycle storage, landscaping, and refuse and recycling storage (Description amended by NMA P/2025/0516)
